responses: Which process do you mean? For example delivery, refunds or returns. Ask me about one and then follow up with 'how long?'.

contextual_responses.refund_policy: Refunds reach your original payment method 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.
contextual_responses.return_process: Pickup is usually within 2 days of booking. After the item reaches our warehouse, inspection takes 2 business days and then the refund is issued.
contextual_responses.shipping_info: Standard delivery: 3-5 business days. Express: 1-2 business days. International: 7-14 business days.
contextual_responses.order_status: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days from dispatch. The ETA I gave above is the latest estimate.
contextual_responses.cancel_order: Approved cancellations are instant and the refund appears in 3-5 business days.
contextual_responses.payment_methods: Cards, UPI and net banking payments are confirmed instantly. Cash on delivery is paid when the parcel arrives.
contextual_responses.warranty: Warranty claims are reviewed within 3 business days; repair or replacement then takes 7-10 days.
contextual_responses.reset_password: The reset email usually arrives within 2 minutes, and the link is valid for 30 minutes.
contextual_responses.change_address: Address changes on a Processing order apply instantly. For shipped orders, redirects take up to 24 hours to confirm.
contextual_responses.refund_status: Refunds take 5-7 business days after we inspect a return (3-5 for cancelled orders). Your bank may add 1-2 days.
contextual_responses.payment_issue: Payments stuck in 'pending' usually resolve within 2-4 hours. Failed payments are refunded to the source within 5-7 business days.
contextual_responses.delayed_delivery: Most delays clear within 1-2 days. If you're more than 5 days past the estimate, contact support and we'll chase the carrier.
contextual_responses.wrong_or_missing_item: Report the problem within 7 days. Pickup is arranged within 2 days, and the replacement or refund follows once we receive the item.
contextual_responses.invoice: Invoices are available as soon as the order ships and are also emailed to you.

contextual_responses.refund_policy: Refunds are free. For change-of-mind returns, a flat ₹50 pickup fee is deducted from the refund.
contextual_responses.return_process: Returns of damaged or wrong items are free. For change-of-mind returns we deduct a flat ₹50 pickup fee.
contextual_responses.shipping_info: Standard shipping is free over ₹499, otherwise ₹49. Express is ₹129 and international is calculated at checkout.
contextual_responses.order_status: Tracking is free. Delivery charges were already included at checkout.
contextual_responses.cancel_order: Cancelling an order is free. There is no cancellation fee.
contextual_responses.payment_methods: There are no fees on cards, UPI or net banking. Cash on delivery has a ₹30 handling fee.
contextual_responses.warranty: Warranty repair or replacement is free. You only pay for damage that isn't covered, such as accidents or misuse.
contextual_responses.promo_codes: Coupons are free to use. Just enter the code at checkout.

responses: Happy to elaborate. Which topic would you like more detail on, such as returns, refunds or shipping?

contextual_responses.refund_policy: Details: items must be unused and returned within 30 days of delivery in original packaging. Digital goods and gift cards are non-refundable. Refunds go to the original payment method.
contextual_responses.return_process: Steps: 1) My Orders > Return, 2) pick a reason, 3) print the label or book a pickup, 4) hand over the packed item. You'll get email updates at each stage.
contextual_responses.shipping_info: We ship to 25+ countries. International parcels may incur customs duties paid by the buyer, and you'll get a tracking link by email once the parcel is dispatched.
contextual_responses.order_status: You'll receive SMS and email updates when the order ships and when it is out for delivery. You can also see live tracking under My Orders.
contextual_responses.cancel_order: Orders can be cancelled while they're still Processing. Once shipped, you can refuse delivery or use the return process instead.
contextual_responses.payment_methods: All payments are encrypted. We never store full card numbers. Saved cards are tokenised by the payment provider.
contextual_responses.warranty: Keep your invoice. It is required for claims. Accidental damage, water damage and unauthorised repairs are not covered.
contextual_responses.promo_codes: WELCOME10 gives 10% off your first order (max ₹300). Codes can't be combined, and sale items may be excluded.
